status: frozen before any test metric of any candidate or control was computed by the evaluation agent
rows: frozen prediction files, rows with split='test' (24h grid, is_live), in_scope and macro scored separately

primary.metric: paired delta Brier = loss(comparator) - loss(candidate), market-weighted
primary.inference: event-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=2000) + cluster-robust t over events

go_criteria.1_brier: lgbm_anchored beats BOTH raw price and ctrl_lgbm_price_only on in-scope test: market-weighted dBrier>0 with event-clustered 95% CI excluding 0; same sign under snapshot and event weighting; beats its own constant-shift (level-only) version; dBrier vs control > 0 on the bias-robust subset; sign not flipped by theatre-cluster inference / leave-one-theatre-out. A secondary candidate (stack_s1, ridge_flow) can only support GO with Holm-adjusted p<0.05 over the 3 candidate-vs-control tests and the same robustness checks.
go_criteria.2_calibration: in-scope test, market-weighted: ECE(candidate) <= ECE(price)+0.01 and |calibration slope-1| <= 0.25
go_criteria.3_returns: frozen-threshold flags, default costs (impact_coef 0.05, $100, latency 60s, fee 0, first signal per market+direction): in-scope test return per $ > 0 with event-clustered 95% CI lower bound > 0, above the price-only control and the rate-matched naive-YES control, and still > 0 (point) at 1% fees

comparators: level_only_<cand>: logit(price) + candidate's own mean test residual (label-free, per universe, market-weighted)
window_selection_controls.bias_robust_subset: markets with scheduled end_date <= 2026-11-10 (data end - 7d): inclusion does not depend on closing early; sensitivity margin 21d; complement reported descriptively
window_selection_controls.diag_breakdown: time from cutoff to event_close buckets (uses the future; diagnostic only)

coarse_clusters: topic (10 in-scope / 10 macro) and theatre (8/9) from pmflow.evaluation.topics (text rules); cluster bootstrap + cluster-robust t with G-1 df + leave-one-theatre-out; with G<=10 these are indicative only
secondary_exploratory: breakdowns by geo_subtype / price bucket / month
mde: 2.80 x clustered SE of each candidate's own paired delta (alpha .05 two-sided, power .8)

controls: naive YES at the candidate's flag rate (20 random draws)
buy YES at every market's first test snapshot

no_tuning: no thresholds, models or variants are changed after scoring; test is scored once
